name: MATCH APP!
source:
The protagonist, Masayan, is a university senior about to graduate. Encouraged by his friend Hiroshi, Masayan decides to dive into the world of dating apps. For the shy Masayan, everything is a first experience, and he's constantly confused... Will Masayan be able to "match" with a woman?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3267520/MATCH_APP/]Steam[/url]]
